plan.summary: BRO-6493: resolve remaining held opening dates using contemporary calendars and venue showcase schedule
steps: BRO-6493: Contemporary February 2025 guide explicitly separates February 15 previews from February 20 opening at St. Anns Warehouse; TDF show listing agrees. Older October 2024 season announcement had a different run start and is not used for this correction. Sources: https://www.tdf.org/on-stage/tdf-stages/17-shows-to-see-off-broadway-in-february/ https://www.tdf.org/shows/22180/safe-house/

BRO-6493: Contemporary May 27, 2026 review roundup explicitly states St. Anns Warehouse production opened May 26, superseding collapsed production-page values. New York Theater opening calendar independently places it May 26 and separates May 17 run start. Sources: https://playbill.com/article/read-the-reviews-for-the-maids-off-broadway https://newyorktheater.me/2026/05/01/may-2026-new-york-theater-openings/

BRO-6493: Contemporary June 2026 opening calendar places BAM production under June 16, while explicitly giving June 9 to 28 run dates. June 16 is the documented opening rather than the June 9 first performance; same-day review coverage corroborates the engagement but is not the source of the date. Sources: https://newyorktheater.me/2026/06/02/june-2026-new-york-theater-openings/ https://www.theatermania.com/news/review-todd-almond-embarks-on-an-odyssey-of-self-reckoning-in-im-almost-there_1842134/

BRO-6493: BAM Fisher September 2026 engagement listing explicitly identifies September 8 opening. TDF gives the same local engagement start, and producer Waterwell identifies the BAM cast separately from its January La MaMa and subsequent tour engagements. Sources: https://www.theatermania.com/shows/brooklyn/the-ford-hill-project_1850611/ https://www.tdf.org/shows/23348/the-ford-hill-project/ https://www.waterwell.org/production/ford-hill-project

BRO-6493: Contemporary opening calendar places this Anthony Rapp East Village Basement production under March 19. TDF contemporary guide explicitly dates first performances March 12, earlier than the calendar run window March 14. Prefer these separately identified dates over an interview that colloquially calls March 14 opening; TDF generic show-page opening label is run start. Sources: https://newyorktheater.me/2026/02/27/march-2026-new-york-theater-openings/ https://www.tdf.org/on-stage/tdf-stages/18-shows-to-see-off-broadway-this-march/ https://www.out.com/theater/anthony-rapp-touch-rent

BRO-6493: Venue identifies this as the annual Youth Company Performance Lab culmination and lists all six free public showcase performances April 10, 11, 16, 17, 18 and 19, 2026. First public showcase date is April 10, not stored April 11; no separate press-night date is identified. This records the opening as the first public showcase rather than inventing a press night. Sources: https://mcctheater.org/tix/uncensored-no-need-to-overthink-it/
